resources.string: Asks GitHub once a day for a new version of the app
Tap to read what is new.

The app can ask GitHub once a day whether a new version of the app is out, and tell you with its release note. GitHub then sees this phone\'s internet address and that it runs the app; nothing else is sent. Download opens the release in your browser: the app never installs anything by itself. You can change this in the Node card, under New versions.
Tells when a new version of the app is out
